6989c69f7d79: What does the standard Salesforce Calendar do?
c9e65ce0cb11: In Lightning Experience the Calendar shows your Events, and any coworker, public or resource calendars you add, in Day, Week and Month views, with a Table view that lists events. You can also add calendars built from any object with a date or date/time field, and create recurring events as an event series.
ad8122f06e83: Can I make a Salesforce calendar view of a custom object?
25bb60eca9fc: Yes. From the Calendar page you can create a calendar from any object with a date or date/time field, filtered by a list view. Each record shows as one item on its start date, or one span from start to end. MultiDatePick also reads any standard or custom object, and shows it in five layouts on record pages, Screen Flows and Experience Cloud sites.
a5f48011b1f4: Can you select multiple dates on a Salesforce calendar?
4d21bc522e7f: Not with the built-in calendar. Clicking a slot creates one event, and a Date field holds one date. MultiDatePick lets users click or drag any number of days on one calendar, add recurring patterns, and save them all at once.
1db7cc9592cd: Does the Salesforce Lightning calendar support recurring events?
217f68ec73e3: Yes. Lightning Experience supports recurring events as an event series. MultiDatePick adds recurring patterns for any record: weekdays, weekends or custom days, which occurrences in the month, and repeat every N weeks.
b2cc1e395a6e: How many items can the Salesforce calendar show?
af191af5e4f5: Salesforce Help says the day, week and month views show up to 150 or up to 500 calendar items in total, depending on your customization options. Items from every calendar you have selected count toward that total.
fba1b6d9742d: Is there a Salesforce calendar app for booking resources with capacity?
45634f4a8872: MultiDatePick Booking. It books any record as the resource, such as a room, vehicle, piece of equipment or a User, with time slots, booked of capacity badges on every slot and a conflict check on save.
ddafb2ff1668: Does MultiDatePick replace the Salesforce Calendar?
debcddd4289a: They work side by side. Keep the Salesforce Calendar for your own meetings and email calendar sync. Use MultiDatePick wherever a record needs many dates, times or bookings.
